title: Matthew Slade, Private Investigator
paragraphs: A short-lived private-detective series following Matthew Slade through murder and mystery cases. Surviving documentation is limited, so this catalog avoids adding unsupported biographical or broadcast details.

KPFK/Pacifica private-eye revival starring William Wintersole as Matthew Slade, also billed as Starlight Mystery Theatre. Frozen subset has eight recordings spanning confirmed 1964 originals, a 1965 rebroadcast identity, and one date-uncertain KPFK/KPFA aircheck.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: KPFK/Starlight Mystery Theatre original run (July 5, 1964 to November 22, 1964) on [[org|org.081e01eef424ad61|KPFK]] and Repeat and service-syndication era (1965 to 1968) on [[org|org.081e01eef424ad61|KPFK]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include William Wintersole (performer), director) (performer), Brian Adams (writer (performer), Robert Frederick (writer), Brian Adams (director and writer), Joyce Reed (performer), and Michael Dayton (technical director and technical producer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] and [[org|org.081e01eef424ad61|KPFK]].
The stories often return to private detective investigation, KPFK/Pacifica radio drama, AFRTS service syndication, murder investigation, and mid-century private-eye drama revival.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes 1964 KPFK private-eye radio revival and 1965-1968 repeat and service-syndication life.
